structured_output.what_is_happening: GHOSTGUY ("Just a ghost guy") is a generic pump.fun meme. It launched about 55 minutes before detection and moved to PumpSwap about 11 minutes before detection. At trigger its market cap was about $76k, close to its all-time high of about $79k. In its first hour on PumpSwap it traded about $61k in volume, with 608 unique buyers against 251 unique sellers and a +26% move over 5 minutes. In raw counts, sells outnumber buys about 2.5 to 1, which fits small bot sells after migration. I found no web, X, Reddit or Telegram discussion. The project's X account was named MOONOnPump about a day ago, which means it is a recycled account.

narrative.description: A generic cute-mascot meme ('just a ghost guy', in the 'just a chill guy' style). I found no link to any current cultural or news event.
narrative.why_spreading: The only visible driver is the pump.fun migration itself, which draws bots and degen traders toward coins that just graduated. I found no evidence of an outside catalyst.

token_connection.why_this_token: This is the only same-name token with liquidity and volume, and it has the project X handle and a DexScreener profile. The two same-name copies are dead: one launched earlier at $1.2k market cap with no liquidity, the other is a later copy at $7.
token_connection.competing_tokens: 4f3wYLuZ... ('Just a Ghost Guy', earlier, dead) and 45JFwikk... (same ticker, later copy, dead)

authenticity.evidence: There are no indexed posts. GMGN counts 44 bundler wallets and 26 snipers, with a fresh-wallet rate of 40% and a bot/degen rate of 47%. There is 1 smart wallet, no KOL wallets and no paid DexScreener boosts. The X account was renamed from MOONOnPump, and the dev's X account has launched 3 tokens and deleted 1 token post.
authenticity.uncertainty: I could not read X (it returned HTTP 402), and private Telegram groups are invisible to me.

structural_risks: Recycled X account (formerly MOONOnPump) and a dev X account that has launched several tokens
44 bundler wallets holding about 11% of the top trader share
A high share of fresh wallets and bot wallets
Price is at its ATH right after migration, so early curve buyers may take profits

structured_output.counterargument: It graduated cleanly with LP burned, mint and freeze renounced, a spread-out top 10 (about 17%), a creator holding only 2%, and more than 600 unique buyers. It is still making new highs with fresh buying 11 minutes after migration. Coins that have just graduated at around $75k can easily double to $150k on momentum alone.
unknowns: What the X account says and how many followers it has
Whether there is a call channel or KOL campaign behind the post-migration push
Whether the bundler wallets are about to sell

source_coverage.notes: A web search on the contract address returned nothing. A search on the name only returned unrelated ghost tokens. Fetching the X profile failed with HTTP 402. The project has no website.

structured_output.thesis: A generic meme with a clean on-chain structure and momentum right after migration, but no narrative I could find and a recycled promo account. It is typical of the pool, with a slightly better structure than average.
